page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number at upper left, running head "EMBLEMA" centred above the title. Title "PATIENTIA VINCIT" with subtitle "omnia." centred. Centre: an engraving (emblem picture, not transcribed as text). Below the picture: four lines of italic verse, centred. Bottom right: catchword-like word "Varie".

l.i: Disce sed ex verbo mentem firmare Iehouæ,
Rebus in aduerfis rupis vt instar ouet:
Grata Deo nulla est patientia, quam nisi firmet Ex verbo diuus Spiritus ille suo.

page.notes: The engraving shows an hourglass-topped skull on a globe held by arms with a sword and scales, a lamb or ram standing on a pedestal, with clouds and hills. Running head and title are set in large italic capitals; the verse lines are italic with long s rendered as s. Initial "D" of the first verse line is a decorated capital. The word at bottom right "Varie" is a printed catchword-like note; it is transcribed as printed. Some words in the verse ("Disce", "fed") are read with some uncertainty and may be "Disce" for "Disce" in the original type.
